author: edwong57
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete GO:0010621 negative regulation of transcription by transcription factor localization

see (https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/30370)

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1QDlYUJ9_HVf-ZFtKWAakBOmXH9a4xif0Kp6OZS44Idg/edit?usp=sharing

Impacted groups: 
BHF-UCL 1 - done
PomBase 1
SGD 3 (will be replaced by GO:0000122)
UniProt 2
WB 1 (will be replaced by GO:0000122)

All annotations are to eukaryotes, so can replace by GO:0000122 [negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GO_0000122)

Annotations can be transferred to GO:0140311 [protein sequestering activity](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GO_0140311)

No mappings

Thanks.
title: Review annotations to GO:0010621 negative regulation of transcription by transcription factor localization
